purpose: Teach: 短縮/共存/退院/各自/待機/早起き/仲介/専業

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業期、お父さん、本気で、絶対、会議、絶対、短縮、絶対、徹底したぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: In the founding days, your father was serious about one thing — he absolutely insisted meetings stay short. He drilled that into us.
lines.style: Measured, deliberate cadence. Sits with the weight of memory. Hands folded. Voice carries respect and quiet conviction. Each phrase lands with finality.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代、本気で、絶対、複数事業、絶対、共存、絶対、上手くされたなあ、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The way he ran multiple businesses at once — how well he managed that — I'm grateful for what he showed us.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost marveling. Slight pause before key words. Warm but formal in register. Eyes focused inward. Voice steady, grounded in admiration.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、社員の、絶対、退院、絶対、必ず、絶対、お見舞いしたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Your father made sure he visited every employee in the hospital. Without fail. That's what he was like.
lines.style: Softer now, almost tender. Slower pace. Voice trails slightly at the end of memories. Posture relaxes. The pride in his voice is understated but unmistakable.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、社員、絶対、各自、絶対、得意を、絶対、活かす社風、絶対、続いております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since his time, we've kept the culture he built — letting each person use their strengths. That legacy continues.
lines.style: Quiet determination. Voice settles deeper, more grounded. Respectful repetition of key ideas. Not lecturing — honoring. A promise made flesh in present tense.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、非常時、絶対、待機、絶対、社員と、絶対、共にしたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Your father stood alongside his staff during crises. He didn't ask them to carry what he wouldn't carry himself.
lines.style: Voice drops to nearly a whisper. Deliberate and solemn. Breath deepens. Each sentence feels like it's been held for decades and is finally being released.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さん、本気で、絶対、早起き、絶対、いつも、絶対、見習っております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I still follow his example — waking early, just like he did every day. It's something I'll always try to do.
lines.style: Simple, unadorned. Voice warm but restrained. No flourish — just honest acknowledgment. The kind of promise that lives in daily small acts.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、取引、絶対、仲介、絶対、信頼で、絶対、ものにしたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Your father built his deals on trust. That's how he won them — not shortcuts, just absolute trust.
lines.style: Voice carries the weight of understanding. Slight emphasis on 'trust' — the cornerstone. Tempo deliberate but not slow. The authority of lived experience.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さん、本気で、絶対、生涯、絶対、商売、絶対、専業、絶対、貫かれましたね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. He devoted his whole life to this business. He never wavered. I owe him everything for that.
lines.style: Final statement, measured and complete. Voice holds steadiness and finality without harshness. Quiet but sure. A man looking back on a life well-honored.
